build_dataset_fiq: build a FIQ (Fine-Grained Image-Text) dataset from JSON captions and image splits
build_dataset_circo: build a CIRCO (Contextual Image Retrieval) dataset from COCO annotations and test queries
build_dataset_dtin: build a DTIN (Domain Transfer) dataset for cross-domain image retrieval evaluation
test_dataset_evaluate_recall: test the Dataset.evaluate_recall method to compute recall@k metrics over retrieved results
test_dataset_write_to_file: test the Dataset.write_to_file method to export retrieval results as JSON
